Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
Upper Text: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon with [Jellymon] in its text or the [DS] trait attacks, by suspending this Tamer, activate 1 of the effects below:
·It may digivolve into a level 6 or lower card with [Jellymon] in its text or the [DS] trait in the hand with the cost reduced by 1.
·You may use 1 Option card with [Jellymon] in its text or the [DS] trait from your hand with the cost reduced by 2.
